# Water Damage Cleanup Houston

> Water Damage Cleanup Houston helps homeowners and businesses in Houston understand and respond to unexpected water damage. We provide clear next-step guidance and connect customers with water removal, extraction, cleanup, drying, and restoration planning services.

## Business facts

- Website: https://water-damage-cleanup-houston.com/
- Service area: Houston, Texas, including Meyerland, Memorial, Kingwood, Spring Branch, Braeswood, and Westbury.
- Phone: (478) 338-9401
- Email: service@water-damage-cleanup-houston.com
- Contact and estimate request: https://water-damage-cleanup-houston.com/estimate

## Services

- [Water Damage Restoration](https://water-damage-cleanup-houston.com/water-damage-restoration): Assessment, drying, cleanup, and restoration planning after water damage.
- [Emergency Water Removal](https://water-damage-cleanup-houston.com/emergency-water-removal): Help with standing water and urgent water intrusion.
- [Water Extraction Services](https://water-damage-cleanup-houston.com/water-extraction-services): Extraction from wet floors, carpeting, and affected rooms.
- [Flood Damage Cleanup](https://water-damage-cleanup-houston.com/flood-damage-cleanup): Cleanup planning for rainwater, stormwater, and indoor flooding.
- [Burst Pipe Water Damage Cleanup](https://water-damage-cleanup-houston.com/burst-pipe-water-damage-cleanup): Cleanup and drying after a burst pipe or plumbing failure.
- [Sewage Backup Cleanup](https://water-damage-cleanup-houston.com/sewage-backup-cleanup): Cleanup planning for sewage backups and potentially contaminated water.

## Important context

Recommendations depend on the source of water, extent of affected materials, contamination risk, and property conditions. For a specific property, an assessment is needed before determining the scope, timeline, or cost of cleanup.
